name: Pioneer 10
location: Leaving the solar system, heading toward the star Aldebaran
tagline: I was the first to cross the asteroid belt and to visit Jupiter.
discovery: I took the first close-up pictures of Jupiter and measured its radiation belts, which were far stronger than expected. These measurements helped design the probes that followed, such as Voyager.
status_note: Lost since January 2003: my signal became too weak to detect. I keep travelling in silence.

presentation.title: If you look up tonight, I'm somewhere out there, very, very far away. I'm Pioneer 10.
presentation.body: I'm an interplanetary probe from the Pioneer 10 mission. I was the first to cross the asteroid belt and to visit Jupiter.

chapters.title: Crossing the belt
chapters.body: In 1972, nobody knows whether a spacecraft can cross the asteroid belt without being destroyed. I am the first to try… and I get through unharmed!

chapters.title: Meeting Jupiter
chapters.body: On 3 December 1973, I pass very close to Jupiter. Its radiation is so strong that it disrupts some of my instruments, but I send back hundreds of pictures of the giant planet.

chapters.title: A message for whoever finds me
chapters.body: I carry an engraved plaque showing a man, a woman and the position of Earth. If someone finds me one day, they will know where I come from. I am heading toward the star Aldebaran, which I will reach in about 2 million years.

quiz.question: Which region was Pioneer 10 the first to cross?
quiz.explanation: Between Mars and Jupiter, the asteroid belt worried engineers. Pioneer 10 proved it could be crossed.

quiz.question: What does Pioneer 10 carry in case someone finds it?
quiz.explanation: The plaque shows two humans and the position of Earth. The music record is Voyager!
